sections.content: CTEs (WITH name AS (SELECT ...)) name a subquery so you can reference it like a table — and chain multiple CTEs for readable multi-step queries.
They shine for: breaking complex logic into steps, reusing a result set, and recursive queries (org charts, bill-of-materials).
Key points: WITH ... AS materializes conceptually, recursive CTEs need UNION ALL + anchor member, and some engines allow INSERT/UPDATE ... RETURNING via CTE.
